procedural_matters: ITA 572 was represented by Noe Gianfranco.
Hearing No. 23 was heard together with hearing No. 24 in accordance with RRS 63.2(b) since both hearings arose from the same incident.
The panel of the international jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
facts: On 28 May 2026, the protest time limit was 18:58.
ITA 572 was protested in hearing No. 16.
Hearing No. 16 was delivered and listed on the Official Notice Board at 18:14.
Hearing No. 16 was scheduled at 18:58 for 19:15.
ITA 572 left the venue and later checked the Official Notice Board for the first time at 19:30.
Hearing No. 16 started at 19:50 and was decided at 20:12.
ITA 572 did not come to the hearing.
ITA 572 requested to reopen hearing No. 16 at 20:12 because he was not present at the hearing.
conclusions: ITA 572 was not unavoidably absent from the hearing. Therefore, the requirements in RRS 63.7(a)(1) for reopening the hearing are not met.
decision: Hearing No. 16 will not be reopened.
